key.name: show-notifications
key.description: Show desktop notifications when OTP codes are copied or clipboard is cleared.

key.name: sort-order
key.description: How accounts are sorted in the popup. Options: manual, alphabetical, last-used.

key.name: code-font
key.description: Font family used to display OTP codes.

key.name: code-size
key.description: Font size in points for OTP code display.

key.name: popup-width
key.description: Width of the popup panel in pixels (320-480).

key.name: dark-icons
key.description: Force dark mode styling for account avatar circles.

key.name: clock-drift
key.description: Number of time windows to check for clock drift (0-2). 0 means exact match only.

key.name: backup-enabled
key.description: Allow exporting accounts as an encrypted backup file.

key.name: lock-on-screen-lock
key.description: Close the popup and require re-authentication when the screen is locked and unlocked.
